name: Gmail
description: Pull recent threads, important mail, and attachments from Gmail into the email domain so briefings and chats are grounded in what's actually in your inbox.
connection: Three connection strategies are supported, tried in priority order: (1) MCP, install an MCP Gmail server (e.g. npx @modelcontextprotocol/server-gmail) and set GMAIL_MCP_COMMAND; (2) OAuth, run `prevail connectors oauth gmail` once (PKCE, saves refresh token to ~/.prevail/connectors/gmail/auth/refresh.token); (3) CLI, install GAM (Google Apps Manager) and authenticate with `gam oauth create`.

connections.description: Local Gmail MCP stdio server. Install via: npm install -g @modelcontextprotocol/server-gmail. Set GMAIL_MCP_COMMAND to the server command.
Direct Gmail REST API via OAuth 2.0 PKCE. Run: prevail connectors oauth gmail
GAM (Google Apps Manager) CLI. Install: https://github.com/GAM-team/GAM. Auth: gam oauth create
